Applies to live-in and live-out domestic workers who regularly do domestic work in one household on an occupational basis (general househelp, yaya, cook, gardener, laundry person); excludes service providers, family drivers and people who work only occasionally or sporadically. measured_for: Tunisia, domestic workers (employés de maison): floor equal to the general SMIG, 48-hour-week basis
note: type=statutory-domestic-min; per hour (48 h regime); derived by law from SMIG. Workers with several employers are legally self-employed but keep the wage guarantee (OpenEdition review).
